text: can you add a log to time the startup time im pretty sure i broke it
resolution: Added phased startup timing for the hmsc-int editor so the suspected boot-time regression is measurable. New leaf module cart/hmsc-int/startupTimer.ts captures t0 at module-eval and exposes startupMark()/startupDone(), each emitting a console.warn (severity-1 reaches the rjit dev terminal next to the [mapgone] trace; severity-0 console.log does not). Marks placed at: index.tsx module-graph evaluated (5.7mb bundle import cost), EditorShell first render (React mounting), applyPayload decode + world-applied phases (useMapSession), PaintCanvas blank first mount, and PaintCanvas real-world remount which fires startupDone (◀ READY total). Each line shows +Nms since t0 and ΔNms since the prior mark, so the slow phase is the big Δ. done-flag silences marks after READY so a later map open/undo (same applyPayload path) does not re-log. Pure diagnostics, no behavioural effect, grep startupTimer to remove. Verified the module transforms via tools/esbuild and all relative import paths resolve; cart-only edits hot-reload in the running dev host. Not committed. Original vague capture; superseded by the clarified hmsc-int scope in req_1628.
